method: obround (R8, centres 40 apart) x 10 minus R2 fillet spandrel R^2(1-pi/4) and 1 mm chamfer triangle swept round the whole loop. Swept volumes use Pappus; Z moments account for inward-offset perimeter P(u)=P-2pi*u: fillet top-depth moment P*A*d-2pi*r^4*(19/24-pi/4), A=r^2*(1-pi/4), d=r*(10-3pi)/(3*(4-pi)); bottom chamfer Z moment P*c^3/6-pi*c^4/12; surfaces use fillet arc centroid inset r-2r/pi
